Özyeğin University Welcomes “The Third Door” Author Alex Banayan

On January 4, Özyeğin University hosted a talk with Alex Banayan, the author of The Third Door, a book recognized by Forbes Magazine as one of the best career books in recent years and ranked among the international best sellers.
Banayan spent seven years researching how some of the world’s most successful individuals, including Bill Gates, Lady Gaga, Larry King, Maya Angelou, Steve Wozniak, Jane Goodall, Jessica Alba, and Quincy Jones, embarked on their career journeys. Recounting the author's seven-year odyssey tracing the footsteps of global trailblazers, the book has also recently been brought to Turkish readers by Boyner Publishing House.
Prior to the event held at Özyeğin University in collaboration with Boyner Publishing House, author Banayan visited the OzU-X Innovation Center, where he gained insights into the center's ongoing initiatives.

Book

Overview
The larger-than-life journey of an 18-year-old college freshman who set out from his dorm room to track down dozens of the world’s most successful people to uncover how they broke through and launched their careers.
The Third Door takes readers on an unprecedented adventure—from hacking Warren Buffett’s shareholders meeting to chasing Larry King through a grocery store to celebrating in a nightclub with Lady Gaga—as Alex Banayan travels from icon to icon, decoding their success.
After remarkable one-on-one interviews with Bill Gates, Maya Angelou, Steve Wozniak, Jane Goodall, Larry King, Jessica Alba, Pitbull, Quincy Jones, and many more, Alex discovered the one key they have in common: they all took the Third Door.

What is The Third Door?

What is

The Third Door?
Life, business, success… it’s just like a nightclub. There are always three ways in.
There’s the First Door: the main entrance, where 99 percent of people wait in line, hoping to get in. The Second Door: the VIP entrance, where the billionaires and celebrities slip through. But what no one tells you is that there is always, always… the Third Door.
